source_structure_findings: Raw interaction rows contain date, partner identity, Interaction value, Sampling_effort_minutes and Sampling_area_square_meters; the previously audited interaction-positive dates can reach the six-bin floor at three island sites and positive-row effort is 120 minutes / 4000 m2.

The EuPPollNet processing script treats flower counts as a separate table and explicitly states that there is no unique ID to merge them to interaction observations. Flower counts are grouped to site x plant x month means and Day is then set to NA.

The EuPPollNet study metadata leaves Sampling_rounds, Sampling_method and Sampling_area_details blank for 51_Petanidou, so the processed metadata does not provide a complete site-date field-visit schedule.

The final EuPPollNet metadata reports study-level sampling days by year, but it does not identify outcome-independent sampling days for each stable Site_id. Therefore zero-interaction site-days cannot be reconstructed without conditioning time-bin inclusion on observing at least one interaction.
gate_reason: The frozen natural-regime gate requires aligned source-native time bins whose inclusion is outcome independent. Using only dates present in positive interaction rows would select bins on the outcome itself. Flower-count dates cannot repair this because source processing removes day identity before merging. The complete site-date interaction sampling frame is therefore not reconstructible from the pinned public source.
robustness_challenge_effect: No source is added. Continue to candidate rank 2, Sicily Bombus, under the frozen order.
claim_boundary: This is a source-structure failure, not evidence about Aegean interaction breadth, synchrony, biology or the NEE route. No natural coordinate was calculated.
